title: HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni
abstract: arXiv:2601.01792v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this report, we present HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni, the first any-to-any omnimodal model in the HyperCLOVA X family that supports text, audio, and vision as both inputs and outputs. By consolidating multimodal understanding and generation into a single model rather than separate modality-specific pipelines, HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni serves as an 8B-scale omni-pathfinding point toward practical any-to-any omni assistants. At a high level, the model unifies modalities through a shared next-token prediction interface over an interleaved multimodal sequence, while vision and audio encoders inject continuous embeddings for fine-grained understanding and grounding. Empirical evaluations demonstrate competitive performance against comparably sized models across diverse input-output combinations spanning text, audio, and vision, in both Korean and English. translated_title: HyperCLOVA X 8B 全模态模型（HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni）
translated_abstract: 在本报告中，我们提出了 HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni，这是 HyperCLOVA X 系列中首个支持文本、音频和视觉同时作为输入与输出的任意到任意全模态模型。通过将多模态理解与生成整合进单一模型，而非采用针对特定模态的分离式流水线，HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni 作为 8B 规模的全模态探索起点，为构建实用的任意到任意全能助手指明方向。在总体设计上，该模型通过对交错的模态序列共享下一词预测接口来统一各模态，同时由视觉和音频编码器注入连续嵌入，以实现细粒度的理解与定位。实证评估表明，在涵盖文本、音频和视觉的多种输入输出组合下，该模型在韩语和英语两种语言中均展现出与同规模模型相比具有竞争力的性能。我们预计 HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni 的开源权重发布将为广泛的研究提供支持。
tldr: HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni 是 HyperCLOVA X 系列首个支持文本、音频和视觉任意输入输出的统一全模态模型，通过共享的下一词预测接口整合多模态理解与生成，在韩英双语下达到与同规模模型相当的性能并计划开源权重。
en_tdlr: HyperCLOVA X 8B Omni is the first any-to-any omnimodal model in the HyperCLOVA X family that unifies multimodal understanding and generation across text, audio, and vision in a single 8B-scale model, achieving competitive performance in both Korean and English with a planned open-weight release.
